messages:
Nora T: Hey team - first week Qs: 1) I filled out my W-4 but forgot to check the extra withholding box. Can I update it retroactively for this pay period? 2) Bought a standing desk for my home office (company allows up to $600 as a one-time remote setup). How do I submit the receipt? 3) Are commuter pre-tax options available?

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Nora! Short answers: 1) Yes we can update W-4 going forward but not retroactively before payroll cutoff; if you email payroll ASAP we may be able to adjust this cycle. 2) Submit the receipt to expenses@redwood.com under category "Home Office Setup" with your manager's approval. 3) Commuter benefits are available via the benefits portal if you're enrolled in the commuter plan. Full details below.

Juan (Payroll): Payroll cutoff is Fri 5pm PT. If you need the W-4 change included in the upcoming run, please email payroll@redwood.com with subject "W4 Update - Nora T - URGENT" and attach the signed form. If cutoff passes we'll apply it next cycle. We cannot backdate tax withholdings.

Nora T: Got it. My purchase was $475. Do I need pre-approval? I didn't ask beforehand.

Finance Bot: Policy: one-time home office stipend/reimbursement up to $600 does not require pre-approval, but receipts + manager sign-off are required. Non-compliant items may be denied. Processing takes 1-2 payroll cycles after approval. If you'd like tax gross-up (rare for non-relocation), indicate that.

Nora T: Thanks. Where do I get manager sign-off? Manager is Sam W. Can I cc them on the expense email?

Maya (People Ops): Yes cc your manager on the expense email. Use this subject: "HomeOffice Reimburse - Nora T - [date]" and include: 1) Receipt, 2) Short note what item was, 3) Manager approval line or forwarded approval. Example in body: 

"Manager approval: Sam W approves $475 reimbursement for standing desk (received 2026-03-12)."

Tax Bot: Commuter benefits: Pre-tax transit and parking elections are available if you enroll during open enrollment or within 30 days of hire. Elections are per-month and withheld pre-tax from your wages. If you want to enroll now, go to benefits.redwood.com/commuter or email benefits@redwood.com to trigger the enrollment task.

Nora T: I missed open enrollment but I'm within 30 days. I'll enroll. One more: if I update my W-4, do I need to re-upload ID docs? I uploaded passport at onboarding.

Juan (Payroll): No need to re-upload ID for W-4 change. We only need the signed W-4. Keep copies for your records. If you changed your name or SSN we'd need docs.

Nora T: Sending payroll email now and submitting expense with Sam cc'd. Thanks all! :raised_hands:

Finance Bot: Expense ticket created: EXP-2026-0991. Payroll ticket: PAY-2026-0834. Expect confirmation emails in 1 business day.
